invention.name: Pocket Moon Remote
invention.description: A tiny remote switches the whole world's gravity to one-sixth strength and back. Its amber ring lifts into a bright cyan orbit in moon mode, while real physics gives you higher, un
invention.usage: Press F to toggle moon gravity. Press Space to jump and steer with WASD. Press F again to restore normal gravity—even in midair.
limitations: Switching gravity does not cancel your current momentum; a fast fall takes time to slow.
Moon jumps take longer to land. Fixed buildings stay anchored.
